experiences.title: NLP Researcher & Data Science Consultant
bullets: Designed and fine-tuned small language models for Named Entity Recognition on financial documents; achieved production-grade accuracy with models under 500M parameters.
Built LLM evaluation pipelines and few-shot classification benchmarks; systematically compared model families (BERT, DeBERTa, Mistral, Llama) across NER, sentiment, and intent tasks.
Led technology watch on LLM post-training, agentic architectures, and efficient inference; authored internal research reports on Active Learning, Weak Supervision, and RAG.

Migrated legacy SAS analytics codebase to Python for Catalina Marketing; built a reusable data-processing toolkit (cleaning, feature engineering, statistical analysis) improving pipeline runtime and maintainability.

experiences.title: Deep Learning Research Engineer --- Cybersecurity
bullets: Designed and trained a 150M-parameter neural network (ResNet-50, Transformer) on 2M samples for Side-Channel Attacks, achieving 85% accuracy on held-out test set.
Studied model robustness and embeddability under adversarial constraints;
Deployed inference pipeline on Jetson Nano (4GB RAM) meeting sub-100ms latency requirement; optimized model quantization and memory footprint for edge deployment.

experiences.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Built a multi-banking customer churn indicator using unsupervised text clustering on transaction narratives; integrated into the production churn-prediction model.
Researched and presented imbalanced classification methods (Autoencoders, SMOTE, ADASYN) to upskill the Data Science team; benchmarked techniques on internal datasets.
